nodes.label: LoopFormer Architecture
nodes.author: Ahmadreza Jeddi, Marco Ciccone, Babak Taati
nodes.rationale: Shortcut-modulated looped Transformer supporting elastic depth. Conditions each loop on normalized time t and step size Δt, enabling budget-conditioned reasoning without retraining. Trained on variable-length trajectories with shortcut-consistency objective.

nodes.label: Loop Trajectory Concept
nodes.rationale: Iterative representation refinement cast as trajectory in representation space. Token states evolve from initial h0 toward target h1 over normalized unit-time horizon. Enables elastic depth: shorter routes yield useful intermediate states, additional steps refine toward shared endpoint.

nodes.label: Elastic Depth Inference
nodes.rationale: Single looped model performing well across user-chosen budgets without retraining. User specifies compute budget M and step schedule; performance scales smoothly with compute rather than collapsing at shorter depths.

nodes.label: Latent Reasoning in Looped Models
nodes.rationale: Reasoning carried out within hidden states rather than explicit chain-of-thought. Looped Transformers possess inductive bias toward latent reasoning, internalizing reasoning skills akin to explicit CoT. Scales gracefully with effective computational depth.

nodes.label: Representation Collapse in Looped Models
nodes.rationale: Early-exit looped baselines exhibit stagnant representations: flat trajectories on curvature, anisotropy, entropy metrics; high CKA indicating minimal change across loop steps. LoopFormer maintains useful representational dynamics through shortcut conditioning and consistency training.

nodes.label: Time and Step-Size Modulation
nodes.rationale: Each loop conditioned on normalized time t ∈ [0,1] and step size Δt ∈ (0,1]. Enables coarser trajectories to approximate fine-grained ones with fewer steps. Modulates RMSNorm scales and gates MHSA/FFN residuals via AdaLN-style mechanism.

nodes.label: Representation Analysis Metrics
nodes.rationale: Four complementary metrics assess token dynamics: anisotropy (pairwise cosine similarity), curvature (local geometric change), prompt entropy (feature spread), CKA similarity (cross-step representational similarity). Diagnose whether models use additional computation or stagnate.

nodes.label: Trajectory Selection Under Fixed Budget
nodes.rationale: Even under uniform training, trajectory choice significantly impacts performance (perplexity spread ~1.4-3 points). Best schedules allocate larger steps early, finer steps late. Optimal schedules for perplexity and reasoning close but not identical.

nodes.label: LoopFormer Training Overhead
nodes.rationale: Dual-trajectory objective adds ~1.5× training FLOPs overhead (full L-loop plus sampled M-loop). Wall-clock slowdown ~1.3× on 4×H100 GPUs. Inference FLOPs similar to vanilla/fixed-loop baselines. Modest overhead enables elastic-depth inference.
